title: agnostic-ai spec frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter for agnostic-ai spec files (agents, skills, rules, hooks, MCPs).

name.description: Spec identifier. Defaults to the filename without extension.

description.description: One-line summary shown in tool listings.

tools.description: Tools the agent may invoke, in Claude Code tool names. Set can or tools, not both.

can.description: What the agent may do, in neutral capability names, which sync writes as the Claude Code tools they stand for. A Claude Code tool name is an alias. Set can or tools, not both. See https://agnostic-ai.org/docs/spec-format/agents/#capabilities

model.description: Preferred model: a scalar for every target, or a map keyed by target name with an optional `default`. See https://agnostic-ai.org/docs/spec-format/agents/#per-target-model-and-effort

effort.description: Reasoning effort on an agent: a scalar for every target, or a map keyed by target name with an optional `default`. Value spaces differ per target. See https://agnostic-ai.org/docs/spec-format/agents/#per-target-model-and-effort

globs.description: File patterns where this rule applies: a comma-separated string or a list of strings. Commas inside a `{...}` brace set do not separate patterns.

alwaysApply.description: Whether the rule injects unconditionally or only on matching context.

scope.description: Routing prefix override. Relative path with forward slashes.

on.description: Portable hook event, which sync translates to each target's own event. Set on or event, not both. See https://agnostic-ai.org/docs/spec-format/hooks/#portable-events

match.description: Tool kind a before-tool or after-tool hook runs on, which sync translates to each target's matcher.

event.description: Hook event that triggers this hook (Claude Code).

matcher.description: Regex on the tool name or other event-specific selector (hooks).

command.description: Shell command (hooks) or executable to launch (MCP stdio).

args.description: Argument list for the MCP command (stdio transport).

env.description: Environment variables passed to the MCP server.

url.description: MCP endpoint URL for http/sse transports.

headers.description: HTTP headers for MCP http/sse transports.
